SELECT FROM attraction_guides g INNER JOIN attractions a ON a.poi_id = g.poi_id WHERE g.poi_id = #{poiId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attraction_guides ( poi_id, summary, content, study_points, questions, visit_tips, cover_url, audio_url, source_name, source_url, source_type, source_text, source_revision, source_license, source_attribution, source_hash, sync_status, sync_error, auto_update, synced_at, status ) VALUES ( #{poiId}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{studyPoints, jdbcType=VARCHAR, typeHandler=com.viyangle.study_tour.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{questions, jdbcType=VARCHAR, typeHandler=com.viyangle.study_tour.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{visitTips}, #{coverUrl}, #{audioUrl}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceText}, #{sourceRevision}, #{sourceLicense}, #{sourceAttribution}, #{sourceHash}, #{syncStatus}, #{syncError}, #{autoUpdate}, #{syncedAt}, #{status} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE summary = VALUES(summary), content = VALUES(content), study_points = VALUES(study_points), questions = VALUES(questions), visit_tips = VALUES(visit_tips), cover_url = VALUES(cover_url), audio_url = VALUES(audio_url), source_name = VALUES(source_name), source_url = VALUES(source_url), source_type = VALUES(source_type), source_text = VALUES(source_text), source_revision = VALUES(source_revision), source_license = VALUES(source_license), source_attribution = VALUES(source_attribution), source_hash = VALUES(source_hash), sync_status = VALUES(sync_status), sync_error = VALUES(sync_error), auto_update = VALUES(auto_update), synced_at = VALUES(synced_at), status = VALUES(status)
mapper.select: SELECT a.poi_id FROM attractions a LEFT JOIN attraction_guides g ON g.poi_id = a.poi_id WHERE (a.status IS NULL OR a.status = 'ACTIVE') AND ( g.poi_id IS NULL OR ( g.auto_update = 1 AND ( g.synced_at IS NULL OR a.updated_at > g.synced_at OR g.synced_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{refreshDays} DAY) OR (g.sync_status = 'FALLBACK' AND g.synced_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) ) ) ) ORDER BY (g.poi_id IS NULL) DESC, g.synced_at ASC, a.poi_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT poi_id FROM attractions WHERE (status IS NULL OR status = 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY updated_at DESC, poi_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
